verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never mentions an app marketplace or installing prebuilt Slack, support-desk, marketing, or data-warehouse integrations. The LinkedIn connection and Teams dialer are built-in features, not marketplace installs. The Web API and Power Apps are developer building blocks for constructing integrations, which earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can install prebuilt integrations (Slack, support desk, marketing, data warehouse) from an app marketplace
